inputs.ad_text_01: A five-second black-and-white historical editorial documentary shot. Fine silver-gelatin photographic grain, neutral grayscale, soft natural light, restrained realistic human gestures, physically coherent surroundings. Locked wide shot, gentle natural motion, crisp photographic detail. No text, no subtitles, no letters, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no split screen, no graphics, no montage, no shot changes. This is an original illustrative reconstruction, not authentic archive footage. A 1930s American industrial street. Six unemployed workers in worn wool coats and flat caps wait quietly in line beside a closed factory gate. A worker looks down at an empty lunch pail, another folds his hands. Human figures and factory entrance dominate the frame. No skyscraper hero shot, no visible signs.
